Messages.Author: Kirill
Messages.Body:
+1 stealth action. Requires a Sabbat vampire.
Put this card on this Sabbat vampire and unlock them. This Sabbat vampire gets +1 intercept during  actions against their controller. A vampire can have only one Abbot.  Do I get +1 intercept during actions against my cards or only against me?

Messages.Author: Snodig
Messages.Body: A  action against your cards is also considered a  action against their controller (you).

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Relevant part in the rulebook:

www.vekn.net/rulebook#6.2.2.resolveanyblockattempts

"1. Who May Attempt to Block: If the action targets one or more other Methuselahs (or things controlled by other Methuselahs), then the action is called directed, "

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Boris The Blade
Messages.Body:
Actually, that line is not really helpful. The question is not whether the action is directed, but against what it is. The rulebook does not answer this clearly, and the way it treats both cases separately would rather hint at the wrong direction. How about:

"If the action targets one or more other Methuselahs (or things controlled by other Methuselahs), then the action is called directed against those Methuselahs, and only the Methuselahs who are targeted (or control the targets) they are the only ones who may use their ready unlocked minions to attempt to block the action"
